name: hypermarrow-memory
display_name: 智商藏不住 · 本地 AI 记忆 MCP
description: Local-first AI memory MCP server. Lets any MCP-compatible client read/write the user's persistent memory (record / recall / consolidation) that lives on the local machine. Privacy-first: nothing leaves the device except calls to the user's own model endpoint.
author: 千视科技 (qianshi.cool)

tools.name: record_context
tools.description: Capture a piece of local context (what the user is working on / a decision made) without uploading.

tools.name: recall_memory
tools.description: Semantic recall of relevant memory given a query, returns ranked context.

tools.name: consolidate
tools.description: Trigger background merge of repeated facts and time-decay of stale memory.

tools.name: file_anchor
tools.description: Anchor an entity to a local file path so 'the spec we discussed' resolves to the real document.

privacy: All memory is stored under the user's local profile; the server only talks to the user's configured model endpoint. No telemetry, no cloud sync.
